svg.aria-label: Original CIFAR-10 FID curves from Rectified Flow Figure 8a, distilled stars omitted; axes relabeled
svg.title: Rectified Flow Fig. 8(a): original FID curves, distilled points omitted
svg.desc: Source plot geometry linearly rescaled from original rectangle x=110,y=117,w=576,h=481. Axis values are the original logarithmic ticks, relabeled for readability. White masks remove only the three isolated distilled star glyphs. Dashed baseline curves remain for context.
